Upstream: https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-hashes/tree/1.8.0
Package: @noble/hashes 1.8.0 (exact package-lock dependency)
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

Redistribution changes in cozy-peace: CommonJS filenames use peace.* names;
relative require targets and package export targets were relocated accordingly.
The cryptographic implementation bodies were retained. These relocated text
files are not byte-for-byte copies of the upstream package. The package API
export keys retain the upstream @noble/hashes/crypto self-reference contract.

manifest.json pins SHA-512 of the actual redistributed files. The KMAC test
compares the SHA-3 implementation bytes with the exact installed upstream
package after only an explicit, bounded require-target relocation. Independent
OpenSSL KMAC and pinned upstream BLAKE3 reference tests verify algorithm outputs.
Uses: standard keyed/derive/XOF/incremental/tree BLAKE3 and SP 800-185 KMAC256.
